name: Call Log
description: A configurable, searchable, call list dashboard for Reminders, Follow ups, Missed Visits and more.

authors.name: Adam Nunez
authors.institution: UW Madison - Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention

newAdhoc.description: Create a new adhoc call for specified record(s). Requires 'record' (or 'record_list'), 'call_type_id', and 'reason_id'.

resolveAdhoc.description: Resolve and complete open adhoc calls matching a call type and reason code for specified record(s). Requires 'record' (or 'record_list'), 'call_type_id', and 'reason_id'.

generate.description: Triggers background evaluation for all configured call types (New Entry, Reminder, Follow-up, MCV, NTS, Visit) across the project to generate active calls.

crons.cron_description: Hourly check for time-sensitive call lifecycles (open reminder expirations, missed appointment calls, and new record intake)
Comprehensive daily synchronization and audit of all call templates across all enabled project records

project-settings.name: Settings such as 'call scripts' (for reminder calls) and 'tasks remaining' must be edited directly in the data dictionary. All Call Log configuration (Call Types, Tabs, Row Expansion) is managed via the project-level Call Log Settings link.
